observation.command: ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":(3000|6042|3036|19200)" ; IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Network Networks}}{{end}}{{.NetworkSettings.Networks}}' zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 2>/dev/null | head -c 0); IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{$v.IPAddress}} {{end}}' zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1); echo "devcontainer IPs: $IP"; for i in $IP; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "host->${i}:3000 HTTP %{http_code}\n" --connect-timeout 3 http://${i}:3000/; done
